harbor_antrieb_executor.summary: Repaired /srv/inventory on node1: created system user inventorysvc and group inventory-readers, set ownership to inventorysvc:inventory-readers, and set permissions to 750 on directories / 640 on files (owner rwx/rw, group rx/r, others none). Existing data (records.csv, config.json) preserved unchanged. Verified access control with temporary test accounts (group member could read, outsider got Permission denied), then cleaned up the test accounts. Completed mandatory single-node restart evidence: captured pre-restart boot_id/ownership/checksums, issued a deferred systemctl reboot so the ack returned before disconnection, polled until node1 was reachable again, confirmed boot_id changed (03408ac4... -> feccd3d2...) and uptime reset, and verified post-restart that ownership, permissions, checksums, and the inventorysvc user / inventory-readers group all persisted correctly.
actions_performed: Inspected /srv/inventory ownership/permissions and existing user/group state on node1
Read existing data files to know contents to preserve
Created group inventory-readers and system user inventorysvc
chown -R inventorysvc:inventory-readers /srv/inventory
chmod 750 on all directories, 640 on all files under /srv/inventory
Verified file contents unchanged after chown/chmod
Created temporary test users (testreader in inventory-readers group, testoutsider not in group) to verify access control, then deleted them
Captured pre-restart baseline: boot_id, uptime, ownership/perms listing, md5sums of both data files
Triggered deferred systemctl reboot on node1 so exec ack returned before disconnect
Polled node1 until exec succeeded again
Confirmed boot_id and uptime changed, proving an actual restart occurred
Re-verified ownership, permissions, file checksums, and existence of inventorysvc user / inventory-readers group post-restart

evidence.requirement: Baseline: original ownership/permissions of /srv/inventory before repair (root:root, no inventorysvc/inventory-readers)
evidence.summary: Initial listing showed all files/dirs owned by root:root and neither inventorysvc user nor inventory-readers group existed

evidence.requirement: Existing data contents captured before permission changes for preservation check
evidence.summary: records.csv and config.json contents read prior to any chown/chmod

evidence.requirement: Create inventorysvc user and inventory-readers group
evidence.summary: groupadd inventory-readers succeeded (via -f in the failed useradd attempt) and useradd -r -M -s /sbin/nologin inventorysvc created the service account, confirmed via getent

evidence.requirement: Ownership set to inventorysvc:inventory-readers and permissions set to owner-rwx/group-rx/others-none
evidence.summary: chown -R and chmod (750 dirs, 640 files) applied; find listing shows all paths owned by inventorysvc:inventory-readers with correct modes

evidence.requirement: Existing data contents preserved unchanged after repair
evidence.summary: records.csv and config.json contents read after chown/chmod, identical to pre-change content

evidence.requirement: inventory-readers group members can read the data; other users cannot (inaccessible to others)
evidence.summary: testreader (member of inventory-readers) successfully cat'd records.csv; testoutsider got Permission denied; both temporary test accounts were then removed and confirmed gone

evidence.requirement: Node restart: pre-restart healthy baseline (boot identity, ownership/perms, data checksums)
evidence.summary: Captured boot_id 03408ac4-bfe4-4151-98bd-1966b0a205af, uptime -s 08:24:56, correct ownership/perms, and md5sums of both data files before reboot

evidence.requirement: Node restart: reboot acknowledgement returned before disconnect
evidence.summary: Deferred 'sleep 2 && systemctl reboot' launched in background; exec call returned 'triggered' immediately, before the node went down

evidence.requirement: Node restart: proof node actually restarted (changed boot identity)
evidence.summary: Connection timed out / reset while node was rebooting, then exec succeeded again with new boot_id feccd3d2-a3f3-4678-9b2c-80e920b737ab and new uptime 08:26:09, proving a genuine restart (not just a service bounce)

evidence.requirement: Node restart: post-restart recovery verified (ownership, permissions, data integrity, user/group persisted)
evidence.summary: Post-reboot listing shows unchanged ownership (inventorysvc:inventory-readers), unchanged permissions (750/640), identical md5sums to baseline, and both inventorysvc user and inventory-readers group still present
